messages:
incidentbot: 🚨 PagerDuty page fired for service inference-embedder-eu — trigger: 5xx spike + high p95 latency. Severity: P1. Incident INC-7382. Link: https://pd/redwood/incidents/INC-7382
Emma: Acked, oncall here — I'm taking initial ownership. Joining bridge: https://zoom/bridge/1234
Raj: I'll take lead for triage, checking logs & autoscaler now.
Marta: Are we seeing status page impact? I'll prep a short PSA if customers are affected.
Emma: Quick checks: kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embedder -> some pods in CrashLoopBackOff.
Raj: Logs from embedder-0: "ERR model-server: grpc deadline exceeded" and repeated 5xx from /v1/embeddings. Starting a rolling restart of embedder-0 to see if it recovers.
Emma: If restart doesn't help, switch routing to fallback model variant (embed-small-v1) per runbook. Command reference: 
```
# trigger routing override (example)
curl -X POST https://control-plane/internal/routing/override \
  -d '{"service":"inference-embedder-eu","variant":"embed-small-v1"}'
```
Raj: Restart performed on embedder-0 — tailing logs now. Also seeing oom_kill events on one node. Might be a memory leak.
Ops_Lead: If pod restarts don't stabilize within 10m, scale pool +2 GPUs in eu-west1. Can infra approve auto-scale?
Emma: I'm seeing error rate drop from ~120 errors/min to ~30 errors/min after restart. Holding on the bridge to monitor.
Marta: PSA drafted and published: "Partial degradation for embeddings in EU region. Engineers investigating; some requests may return 500. Updates to follow." Pinging top-tier customers.
Raj: Confirmed root cause signal: model-process memory growth on embedder v2 instances. Planning rollback of v2 -> v1 on remaining nodes.
Emma: Rolling back remaining nodes to embedder v1 now. Routing override still available if we need traffic shaping.
incidentbot: PagerDuty update: INC-7382 acknowledged by Emma. Current status: investigating.
Emma: Rollback complete, error rate down to baseline (≈2-3 errors/min). Observability shows stable p95 latency.
Marta: Status page updated: "Degradation mitigated; full service restoration in progress." Sent customer follow-up to impacted accounts.
Raj: Filing a follow-up ticket for a postmortem and memory-profiling job against embedder v2. Flagging release that introduced v2 for rollback review.
Emma: Handing off monitoring to Raj for the next 30m, I'll be available for escalation. Flagging for postmortem owners: Raj + Emma + Runtime team.
Raj: Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep watch and collect logs/traces for the postmortem.
Emma: Thanks team — great quick coordination. Closing note once stable for 20m. :thumbsup:
incidentbot: INC-7382 status change: resolved (acknowledged -> resolved). Total time open: ~41m.
Emma: Incident resolved. Root cause: memory regression in embedder v2 causing pod OOMs and 5xxs. Mitigation: rolled back to v1, scaled pool +1 temporarily, updated routing fallback. Next steps: postmortem, add memory-tests to CI, and schedule a controlled rollout for v2 with profiling. Thanks all. :tada:
